name: Chau Doc Market
kicker: Town market for the morning bowl
summary: Town market for the morning bowl: eat bún cá at the edge of Chợ Châu Đốc, then walk the mắm stalls. Boats unload produce on the waterfront, and flowers, fruit, and vegetables sit on the sidewalk. Fish pickle ferments in the open. The hall runs 05:30–18:00. Come in the morning.
getThere: In the town center, phường Châu Đốc. Walk from a river room.
heroCaption: The market hall signed Chợ Châu Đốc

notice.title: Come in the morning
notice.body: The hall runs 05:30–18:00. Breakfast is bún cá at the edge, with mắm in the aisles and boats unloading on the waterfront. A late stop misses that landing.

body: Start with bún cá and coffee at the edge of the hall, then walk inside for mắm. Fish pickled with palm sugar, salt, chili, and garlic sits in the open, with tamarind, jellied sweets, and more fish. On the waterfront, boats unload produce. Flowers, fruit, and vegetables line the sidewalk. Look up at the old shop-sign lettering.

Two halls both carry the name Chợ Châu Đốc: the white front with the fan window, and the blue hall on the street. Season the bún cá with chili and lime. A bowl is about 10,000–30,000 VND. Ask at the stall.
The hall is open 05:30–18:00 every day. Chợ quê làng Chăm in Đa Phước is a different walk from this hall.

figures.caption: The blue hall, also signed Chợ Châu Đốc, with the street in front
figures.alt: The blue Chau Doc Market building with motorbikes and produce on the street

gettingThere: The market is in the town center, phường Châu Đốc. If your room is on the river, walk. From a bungalow on Núi Sam, come by road.

legs.heading: From a river room in phường Châu Đốc
legs.body: On foot, into the town center.

hours: 05:30–18:00 every day. Come in the morning for breakfast and the landing.
closed: Open every day. Check the board on arrival.
admissionNote: Check on arrival for a gate fee. A bowl is about 10,000–30,000 VND. Ask at the stall.
